summon_bonuses.label: Magic
summon_bonuses.description: The caster's force of will steadies a summoned creature's mind: CHA - 5, never below 0, on its INT and WIL: half at rank 1, all at rank 2.

summon_bonuses.label: Physical
summon_bonuses.description: The caster's presence drives a summoned creature's body: CHA - 5, never below 0, on its STR, END, and AGI: half at rank 1, all at rank 2.
